test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 2 (Held On: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.**

A herd of wild goats invaded a deserted town in Wales during the lockdown.

options.text: A herd of wild goats in Wales was invaded by a deserted town during the lockdown.
A deserted town in Wales was invaded by a herd of wild goats during the lockdown.
A deserted town in Wales is being invaded by a herd of wild goats during the lockdown.
A deserted town in Wales has been invaded by a herd of wild goats during the lockdown.

solution: The correct answer is **'A deserted town in Wales was invaded by a herd of wild goats during the lockdown.'** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The given sentence is in Active Voice. As per the given question, we have to change it into Passive Voice. • The structure of the given sentence is as follows: • Subject + V2+ Object. (Active Voice) • Subject (objective case)+ was/were + V3 + Object (subjective case). (Passive Voice) • *Example:* • *Their cousin showed them some rare photographs. (Active Voice)* • *They were shown some rare photographs by their cousin. (Passive Voice)* • The subject of the given sentence is 'A herd of wild goats'.​​ • The object of the given sentence is 'A deserted town in Wales'. • The subject will be put in place of the object and the object will be put in place of the subject. • And 'invaded' will be changed into 'was invaded'. ​ Correct Sentence:__ *A deserted town in Wales was invaded by a herd of wild goats during the lockdown.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__** • दिया गया वाक्य Active Voice में है। दिए गए प्रश्न के अनुसार हमें इसे Passive Voice में बदलना है। • दिए गए वाक्य की संरचना इस प्रकार है: • Subject + V2+ Object. (Active Voice) • Subject (objective case)+ was/were + V3 + Object (subjective case). (Passive Voice) • *Example:* • *Their cousin showed them some rare photographs. (Active Voice)* • *They were shown some rare photographs by their cousin. (Passive Voice)* • दिए गए वाक्य का विषय 'A herd of wild goats' है।​ • दिए गए वाक्य का object 'A deserted town in Wales' है। • Object के स्थान पर Subject रखा जाएगा और Subject के स्थान पर Object रखी जाएगी। • 'invaded' को 'was invaded' में बदल दिया जाएगा। c7:T1259, The correct answer is **He said, “My new slippers are very comfortable.”**
